title: Work‑time problem to find n
subject: Mathematics
caption: Flowchart showing the derivation of the work‑time relationship and solving the proportion 6 : 11 to find n = 7.
altText: A step‑by‑step flowchart starting with the given work amounts, defining variables for work done by 6 men in x days and 11 men in y days, using the formula work = men × days to create the equation 6·x = 11·y, forming the proportion 6:11 = x:y, solving for the unknown n, calculating n = 7, and verifying the result before ending.
